text: The first surprise is structural. Lana found at least five different proposals under this label, Black Hole Universe, or BHU for short. One identifies a closed universe with a black hole. Another says collapse rebounds abounds instead of crushing to a point. Another inherits rotation. Cosmological natural selection asks whether black hole production shapes physical constants, the fixed numbers built into physics. Other Baby Universe work points to different observables. They do not share one forecast.
